events.title: In Conversation with Leah Purcell
events.location: Queensland Performing Arts Centre (QPAC), South Brisbane
events.description: An opportunity to engage in a talk and conversation with one of Australia's leading artists, Leah Purcell AM. This event connects with cultural insights and storytelling.

events.title: GOMA Friday Nights: Presence
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: Experience the 'Olafur Eliasson: Presence' exhibition after hours, featuring curated music, DJs, cocktails, snacks, and pop-up performances. A unique blend of art, music, and social connection in an inspiring atmosphere.

events.title: Museum Highlights Tour
events.description: Join knowledgeable guides on a free tour of the Queensland Museum, uncovering fascinating stories behind its treasured objects. This ongoing event is suitable for curious minds interested in history and culture.

events.title: Croc! Lost Giants to Living Legends (Exhibition)
events.description: An interactive exhibition at the Queensland Museum exploring the world of crocodiles, from prehistoric giants to living legends. It offers a scientific and historical journey suitable for all ages, running until October 2026.

events.title: Make a Scene: Fashioning Queer Identity and Club Culture in the 90s (Exhibition)
events.description: This exhibition at the Queensland Museum features pieces from textile and costume collections, revealing stories of Queensland's LGBTQIA+ communities. It explores the intersection of fashion, identity, and 90s club culture.

events.title: Resin Art Workshop
events.description: Unleash your creativity in this interactive resin art workshop where expert instructors teach resin pouring. Suitable for all skill levels, you'll create unique pieces using provided tools and materials alongside other creatives.

events.title: Redlands Coast AdventureFest: Heritage Artisan Faire Workshops
events.description: Part of the Redlands Coast AdventureFest, these workshops offer a chance to immerse in timeless crafts, celebrating local creative talent and heritage. Specific craft types will be detailed in the full festival program.

events.title: The Waterboys
events.description: Catch Scottish-Irish folk rock band The Waterboys live, with Ella Hooper, at The Tivoli. This intimate gig promises a strong artistic performance for fans of folk rock.

events.title: Ivan Aristeguieta: Ready To Mambo
events.description: Enjoy a stand-up comedy performance by Venezuelan-Australian comedian Ivan Aristeguieta, as part of the Brisbane Comedy Festival at The Tivoli.

events.title: The Fairbairns: Fair Dinkum
events.description: Another offering from the Brisbane Comedy Festival, featuring the Australian comedy act, The Fairbairns, performing their show 'Fair Dinkum' at The Tivoli.

events.title: Luke Heggie: I Won't Say It Again
events.description: Stand-up comedy performance by Luke Heggie as part of the Brisbane Comedy Festival, promising his signature style. Check The Tivoli website for specific showtimes.

events.title: Daniel Muggleton Concert
events.description: A stand-up comedy performance by Daniel Muggleton at the Brisbane Powerhouse. Check the Powerhouse website for direct tickets and more information.

events.title: GRIMM – Tales from the Brothers Grimm
events.location: Queensland Performing Arts Centre (QPAC), South Brisbane
events.description: An immersive theatre experience by Shake & Stir Theatre Co, bringing the classic tales of the Brothers Grimm to life at QPAC. This production runs until June 13, 2026.

events.title: Enter Shikari
events.description: Live music performance by the British rock band Enter Shikari, with support from grandson, at The Tivoli. Expect a high-energy show.

events.title: After Hours (Brisbane Comedy Festival)
events.location: Fairfax Studio, Brisbane Powerhouse, New Farm
events.description: Brisbane Comedy Festival’s late-night variety show featuring a mix of special festival acts and top-tier local comedians. It’s a chance for comedians to get loose and try new material, promising an unpredictable and engaging night for an 18+ audience.

events.title: Abseiling at Kangaroo Point Cliffs
events.description: A classic Brisbane adventure offering guided abseiling sessions down the iconic Kangaroo Point Cliffs. This activity caters to thrill-seekers and those looking for an active outdoor experience.

events.title: Wall Walkers Bouldering (Unlimited Climbing Deal)
events.description: An unlimited climbing deal for two weeks at Wall Walkers Bouldering. This offers an excellent opportunity to engage in adventure-oriented physical activity and connect with a community of climbers.

events.title: Sense & Soma - Group Somatic Embodied Movement Session
events.location: Vera Wellness Studio, North Brisbane | Samford Valley
events.description: A mindful movement session led by Claire Stephensen, designed for individuals experiencing chronic pain, trauma, or stress. It offers a space for authentic self-expression and connection through embodied practices.

events.title: Yoga for Busy Minds: A Mid-Year Reset
events.description: A restorative yoga workshop led by Kayla Duckham, focusing on mental wellbeing. It incorporates gentle movement, breathwork, and meditation, offering tools to manage stress and regulate the nervous system.

events.title: Sustainable BNE Festival
events.description: A community festival celebrating sustainability, typically featuring stalls, workshops, and talks related to environmental issues, eco-friendly living, and local initiatives. Expected to be a day-long event with a mix of free and paid activities.
